title: Silver Support Scheme eligibility and the $140,000 CPF threshold
asked: Assoc Prof Jamus Jerome Lim asked whether the Ministry has reviewed the $140,000 lifetime CPF contribution threshold for Silver Support eligibility, and what considerations guide adjustments given cost-of-living changes affecting seniors reliant on CPF payouts.
response: Dr Tan See Leng said the Ministry periodically reviews Silver Support eligibility criteria. He noted the lifetime CPF contribution threshold was doubled from $70,000 to $140,000 in 2021, and in 2025 the monthly per capita household income threshold was raised from $1,800 to $2,300, with quarterly payments increased by 20%. About 290,000 seniors aged 65 and above currently benefit. He also pointed to the Assurance Package and GST Voucher schemes, enhanced in 2025, as support for cost-of-living concerns.

key_points.point: The Ministry periodically reviews Silver Support eligibility criteria.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: The Ministry periodically reviews the eligibility criteria for the Silver Support Scheme.

key_points.point: The lifetime CPF contribution threshold was doubled from $70,000 to $140,000 in 2021.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: In 2021, the total Central Provident Fund (CPF) contribution (TCC) threshold, which reflects the income that seniors earned during their working years, was doubled from $70,000 to $140,000.

key_points.point: In 2025, the qualifying monthly per capita household income threshold was raised from $1,800 to $2,300, about a 28% increase.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: In 2025, we raised the qualifying monthly per capita household income threshold, from $1,800 to $2,300 – this is about an approximate 28% increase.

key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: We also increased the quarterly payments by 20%.

key_points.point: About 290,000 seniors aged 65 and above currently benefit from the scheme.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: About 290,000 seniors aged 65 and above currently benefit from the scheme.

key_points.point: The Assurance Package and GST Voucher schemes were enhanced in 2025.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: This includes the Assurance Package, and the Goods and Services Tax (GST) Voucher schemes, which were enhanced in 2025.

key_points.point: He said the comparison with CPF Full Retirement Sum adjustments is not like-for-like and Silver Support should be viewed holistically.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: I do not think it is a like-for-like comparison.

key_points.point: He cited other support schemes including the Pioneer Generation Package, Merdeka Generation Package and Majulah Package.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: such as the Pioneer Generation Package to the Merdeka Generation Package to the Majulah Package.

key_points.point: He said the parameters of the Silver Support Scheme are periodically reviewed and refined.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: we periodically review the parameters in which the Silver Support Scheme is improved and refined.

key_points.point: He said the Government constantly reviews frameworks and criteria to better support elderly Singaporeans.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: Indeed, we constantly review the frameworks, the criteria, as to how we can better support all of our elderly Singaporeans.

key_points.point: He said fiscal sustainability is balanced with fiscal prudence, with savings boosted through top-ups.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: When we balance fiscal sustainability with fiscal prudence, we also – if I may use a medical word – we also immunise and boost some of the savings along the way through top-ups.

key_points.point: He listed the Majulah Package, GST Vouchers, Community Development Council Vouchers and cost-of-living vouchers as support for elderly Singaporeans.
key_points.speaker: Dr Tan See Leng
key_points.quote: we have introduced the Majulah Package, we have enhanced this Silver Support Scheme, we have also introduced, at various points, the GST Vouchers, Community Development Council Vouchers, cost-of-living vouchers to support and uplift our elderly Singaporeans.

left_open: Whether the $140,000 lifetime CPF contribution threshold itself has been reviewed or will be adjusted.
What specific considerations guide adjustments to the threshold in light of cost-of-living changes for seniors reliant on CPF payouts.
supplementary: Whether the Silver Support eligibility criteria, especially the lifetime CPF contribution threshold, should be reviewed or adjusted.
